heading.en: These By-Laws may be cited as the Bandar Seri Begawan Municipal Board

text.en: These By-Laws may be cited as the Bandar Seri Begawan Municipal Board (Standing Orders] By-Laws, 2018.

heading.en: "Board" means the Bandar Seri Begawan Municipal Board;

text.en: In these By-Laws, unless the context requires otherwise - "meeting" means any meeting of the Board; "member" means member of the Board; "secretary" means the person appointed by the Chairman to be the secretary; "working day" means any day other than a Friday, Sunday or public holiday.

text.en: The procedure prescribed under these By-Laws shall be observed for the order and conduct of business of the Board and any of its committee. Frequency, time and place of meetings

OF PROCEEDINGS

(1) At a meeting, two-thirds of the members shall form a quorum.

(2) No business of the Board shall be transacted at any meeting thereof unless a quorum is present. Chairman to preside

(1) As soon as a quorum is present, the Chairman shall take the chair and call the members to order. ( 2 ) The Chairman shall preside at any meeting of the Board and shall have the general control of all deliberations and proceedings of the meeting.

(3) If the Chairman is absent or for any other reason is unable to discharge his functions, the members present may elect one of them to preside at the Duties of secretary

heading.en: The secretary shall -

text.en:
The secretary shall -

(a) under the direction of the Chairman, have charge of all correspondence and documents of the Board; and

(b) in all other respects, carry out such duties as may be imposed upon him by these By-Laws or assigned to him by direction of the Chairman. 26th. JULY, 2018

(1) The secretary shall keep minutes of all meetings.

(2) As soon as possible after every meeting, a copy of the draft minutes shall be sent to members. If on confirmation such draft minutes are amended, the Chairman shall forthwith be informed of the amendments made. Adjournment of meeting

text.en: When two or more members arise to speak at the same time, the Chairman shall name the member who, in his opinion, has right of precedence. Member to address Chairman while speaking

text.en: Every member while speaking shall respectfully address the Chairman.

heading.en: The Brunei Municipal Board (Standing Orders) By-Laws, 1963 is hereby

text.en:
The Brunei Municipal Board (Standing Orders) By-Laws, 1963 is hereby repealed. Made this 3rd. day of Ramadhan, 1439 Hijriah corresponding to the 19th. day of May, 2018.

AWANG HAJI ALI BIN MATYASSIN Bandar Seri Begawan Municipal Board. Confirmed this 26th. day of Syawal, 1439 Hijriah corresponding to the 10th. day of July, 2018.

PEHIN ORANG KAYA SERI KERNA DATO SERI SETIA (DR.) HAJI AWANG ABU BAKAR BIN HAJI APONG Minister of Home Affairs, Brunei Darussalam.
